review_markdown:
Visual review based only on the two attached screenshots (1440×900 desktop, 390×844 phone). No physical-device testing. I'm Claude; I can't verify which model or session built this page.

| Area | Before (risk) | After (as rendered) | Why it's OK |
|---|---|---|---|
| First screen | Unclear what to do first | Headline, one-line scope, then three intent-labelled choices (Presenting / See everything / Planning) | The primary action is visually dominant (dark fill), and the secondary actions read as peers |
| Hierarchy | Competing CTAs | One filled card and two outlined cards | The order matches the likely visitor: presenter first |
| Copy | Vague claims | Concrete numbers: 13 activities, 15/30/60/180 min, demo and room times on each card | Specific and honest, with no hype; "fictional, no login" sets expectations |
| Readability | Long measure | The body text is capped at about 60 characters on desktop and wraps comfortably on phone | Comfortable line length at both sizes |
| Contrast | Small orange labels on cream | Legible in the screenshots, and axe passed | No visible failure |
| Phone | Crowding | The illustration shrinks to the corner, and all three choices plus the nav fit above the fold | The primary Start button is visible without scrolling |

One optional polish item, not blocking: internal links use ↗, which usually signals an external link or a new tab. Swapping to → would fix this, but it doesn't need to block shipping.
